extraFacts.fact: Pipe flange types: welding neck (tapered hub butt-welded to the pipe), slip-on (slides over the pipe, fillet-welded), socket weld (pipe inserted into a socket), threaded, lap joint (loose flange over a stub end, which is butt-welded to the pipe), blind (closes the end of a line); gunmetal is a bronze alloy of copper, tin and zinc. ASME B16.5 covers pipe flanges and flanged fittings NPS 1/2 to 24 in Classes 150 to 2500; MSS SP-43 covers wrought stainless steel butt-welding fittings including stub ends.
extraFacts.source: ASME B16.5; ASME B16.9; MSS SP-43

faqs.q: What is the Blind Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs used for?
faqs.a: The Blind Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs is a blind flange with a solid disc that closes the line. A blind flange closes the end of a pipe, valve or nozzle and can be removed later for access or pigging. It is listed from 1/2" to 24" and sits on the [industrial flanges shelf](/c/industrial-flanges).

faqs.q: Which faces and end configurations does the Blind Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs come with?
faqs.a: End A is "Blind — closes the line" and end B is "Flange face — raised (RF), flat (FF) or ring-joint (RTJ)", listed as RTJ, RF & FF. Match the face to the mating flange: a ring-joint face needs a ring-joint flange, and a raised face should not be bolted against a flat-faced cast or lined flange.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Blind Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs cover?
faqs.a: The Blind Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs is listed from 1/2" to 24" (1/2" through 24" in the ANSI / ASME size range). Specify the exact size on the request, because lead time depends on size and material.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the Blind Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs have?
faqs.a: Under ASME B16.5 at ambient temperature Class 150 is 285 psi in A105 carbon steel and 275 psi in 304 or 316 stainless, and Class 300 is 740 psi and 720 psi. The rating falls as temperature rises, so give the working temperature when you ask for the blind flange.

faqs.q: What materials is the Blind Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs made in?
faqs.a: The blind flange is listed in ASTM A105, ASTM A182 316, ASTM A182 304. A105 is carbon steel and the A182 grades are 304 and 316 stainless, so choose the grade that suits the fluid and the mating pipe.

faqs.q: Which standard does the Blind Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs follow?
faqs.a: The Blind Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs follows ASME B16.5, Class 150 and 300. Under ASME B16.5 the rating depends on the class, the material and the temperature. Ask for the material certificate on your request if the job needs one.

faqs.q: What does the Blind Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs bolt to, and how is it fitted?
faqs.a: The blind flange has a solid disc that closes the line, and it bolts to a mating flange of the same size, class and face. See the [flanged hose connections guide](/blog/flanged-hose-connections) for how flanges fit on industrial hose.

faqs.q: How do I order the Blind Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs correctly?
faqs.a: Specify the size, the body material where more than one is listed, and any thread, tail or gasket variant on the request, and Indus engineering confirms the manufacturer part number against your application. For the blind flange state the class and face too.

faqs.q: Where is the Blind Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs used?
faqs.a: The blind flange is used to make bolted, removable joints between pipe, hose ends and equipment on industrial lines. A blind flange closes the end of a pipe, valve or nozzle and can be removed later for access or pigging.

faqs.q: How does the Slip On Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs differ from the Welding Neck Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs?
faqs.a: The welding neck flange has a tapered hub butt-welded to the pipe, which is stronger under pressure and fatigue. The [Welding Neck Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs](/p/welding-neck-flange-asme-b16-5-150-300-lbs) is the alternative; the Slip On Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs is the one with a bore that slips over the pipe and is fillet-welded. Both are listed from 1/2" to 24".

faqs.q: What is the Socket Weld Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs used for?
faqs.a: The Socket Weld Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs is a socket weld flange with a socket for a socket-welded pipe. The pipe is inserted into a socket and fillet-welded, which suits small-bore lines where a butt-weld would be hard to align. It is listed from 1/2" to 24" and sits on the [industrial flanges shelf](/c/industrial-flanges).

faqs.q: Which faces and end configurations does the Socket Weld Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs come with?
faqs.a: End A is "Socket for a socket-welded pipe" and end B is "Flange face — raised (RF), flat (FF) or ring-joint (RTJ)", listed as RTJ, RF & FF. Match the face to the mating flange: a ring-joint face needs a ring-joint flange, and a raised face should not be bolted against a flat-faced cast or lined flange.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Socket Weld Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs cover?
faqs.a: The Socket Weld Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs is listed from 1/2" to 24" (1/2" through 24" in the ANSI / ASME size range). Specify the exact size on the request, because lead time depends on size and material.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the Socket Weld Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs have?
faqs.a: Under ASME B16.5 at ambient temperature Class 150 is 285 psi in A105 carbon steel and 275 psi in 304 or 316 stainless, and Class 300 is 740 psi and 720 psi. The rating falls as temperature rises, so give the working temperature when you ask for the socket weld flange.

faqs.q: What materials is the Socket Weld Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs made in?
faqs.a: The socket weld flange is listed in ASTM A105), ASTM A182 316, ASTM A182 304. A105 is carbon steel and the A182 grades are 304 and 316 stainless, so choose the grade that suits the fluid and the mating pipe.

faqs.q: Which standard does the Socket Weld Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs follow?
faqs.a: The Socket Weld Flange ASME B16.5 150/300 lbs follows ASME B16.5, Class 150 and 300. Under ASME B16.5 the rating depends on the class, the material and the temperature. Ask for the material certificate on your request if the job needs one.
